steps.purpose: Give every durable Context one lowest-owning Room so retrieval has an explicit product boundary instead of a flat global bag.
derives_from: Repository code, docs, and existing product boundaries named by those claims.
steps.good_value: The smallest Room tree that covers territory actually read, with each Context placed in the lowest Room that owns the whole claim and every affected Ticket context_ref rewritten to that reviewed destination.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not invent Rooms for repository territory that was not read.
Do not assign by filename, tag, or directory similarity when the Context claim belongs elsewhere.
Do not leave copies, a populated legacy .vibehub/context/ directory, dual paths, or guessed Ticket refs.
instructions: Build the Room tree with vibehub-distill when .vibehub/rooms/ is missing or empty.
Move each legacy Context with Git into its reviewed lowest-owning Room and remove the empty legacy directory.
Rewrite every exact Ticket context_ref from the old path to the reviewed new path, then rerun the mechanical operation.

steps.purpose: Record whether and exactly where each Ticket outcome was delivered so status and current branch state are not mistaken for historical delivery truth.
derives_from: Exact reviewable Git history for the Ticket and candidate delivery commit.
Canonical merged GitHub pull-request metadata when a pull request delivered the outcome.
An exact delivered cherry-pick commit when no canonical pull request is authoritative.
steps.good_value: Each authoritative delivery records the canonical ref, delivered state, exact timestamp, and 40-hex delivered commit; a genuinely undelivered Ticket remains empty only after the same history audit.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not infer delivery from Ticket status, branch name, filename, prose, or whichever pull request is currently open.
Do not invent a delivery when exact history cannot establish one.
Do not treat the mechanically written empty array as a completed classification.
instructions: Audit each Ticket against exact reviewable history and populate only authoritative deliveries.
Leave deliveries empty when no authoritative delivery can be established.
Remove migration-pending:format-1-to-format-2:classify-delivery-membership from that Ticket's provenance_refs only after its audit is complete.

migrations.detect: project compatibility returns MIGRATION_REQUIRED with detected_format 2 and target_format 3 after immutable historical Ticket context refs became readable project data.

steps.purpose: Replace a temporary deleted-path provenance workaround with readable immutable Ticket Context only when reviewable Git history identifies the exact commit and blob that informed that Ticket.
derives_from: Each exact deleted-path provenance entry and the Ticket that carries it.
The Ticket-creation or decision commit and its parent history, not merely any commit in which the path happened to exist.
The shared context resolve operation proving the selected commit names a regular historical blob with the expected bytes.
steps.good_value: An established case moves from deleted-path:<path> provenance to a context_ref whose ref is commit:<40-hex>:<path> and whose purpose states why those exact bytes informed the Ticket; an ambiguous case keeps an explicit unresolved deleted-path provenance note.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not choose the newest, oldest, or any containing commit without evidence that it is the version the Ticket actually used.
Do not restore or copy the retired file into the working tree, Ticket, archive, cache, or database.
Do not remove an unresolved deleted-path note or imply that mechanical migration completed semantic selection.
instructions: Audit every deleted-path provenance entry against the Ticket's exact Git history and record reviewable Evidence for the selection or ambiguity.
For an established case, add commit:<40-hex>:<repo-relative-path> to context_refs, verify it with context resolve, and remove only the matching deleted-path provenance entry.
For an ambiguous case, retain a deleted-path provenance note that explicitly says selection remains unresolved, then validate the project.
